units: <cite ref="Gittin 56a:8">Gitt. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>כל … כשהוא ר׳ וכ׳</he> whoever entered his house hungry like a dog came out satisfied.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 34:13">Lev. R. s. 34</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 58:10">Is. LVIII, 10</cite>) <he>אם זכיתם לרְעֵבוֹ של יעקב וכ׳</he> if you do good, you will give to the hungry one of Jacob, if not, to the satisfied one of Esau (to the Roman oppressor); a. fr., v. next w.—Pl. <he>רְעֵבִים</he>.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 109:13">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXVIII, 19</cite> <he>מאכיל ר׳ הייתי</he> I have been a feeder of the hungry; <he>זה השער של מאכיל ר׳</he> this is the gate for him who fed the hungry.
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 146:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. CXLVI, 7</cite> <he>ומי הם הר׳ זה וכ׳</he> and who are the hungry (to whom the Lord gives bread)? Such as Elijah who was hungry &c.; a. e.
